scenes.text: Did you absolutely know that the modern design of the US Space Shuttle was actually decided over two thousand years ago by the physical backside of a Roman horse?
The shuttle's massive solid rocket boosters had to be shipped by train through a very narrow mountain tunnel, meaning they simply couldn't be made any wider than the standard American railroad track.
But those railway tracks were built using the exact same measurements as old English tramways, which used the same jigs and tools originally created for building ancient Roman war chariots.

Since those Roman chariots were built just wide enough to fit two horse backsides, our most advanced space technology was ultimately limited by ancient horse anatomy—hit follow for more mind-blowing history!
